strings.jp: 「{kata}キシシシシシッ{hira}!{n} 来たな! {sub:A0}!」{n}{n}「{sub:B6}を たおせば{n} この{kata}キジ{hira}を 食ってよいと{n} {kata}カルラ{hira}様が もうされた!」{n}「{kata}キジ{hira}は さぞかし うまいだろな!{n} もちろん あとで {sub:B6}も{n} 食べるがな! {kata}キシシシシシッ{hira}!」
strings.en: "Kishishishishishi!{n} So you came, Momotaro!"{n}{n}"Lady Karura said that if I beat you,{n} I could eat this Pheasant!"{n}"I bet Pheasant tastes delicious!{n} And of course, I'll eat you{n} afterward too! Kishishishishishi!"

strings.jp: 「{kata}ケン{hira} {kata}ケン{hira}! {sub:A0}さん!{n} {sub:C9}です!{n} {kata}キジ{hira}の {arg}です!」{n}「とっても こわかったけど{n} きっと たすけてくださるって{n} {arg}は 信じてました!」{n}「おこしに つけた きびだんご!{n} ひとつ {sub:C9}に {sub:C5}な?{n} 旅のおともを いたしましょう!」
strings.en: "Ken, ken! Momotaro!{n} It's me!{n} {arg} the Pheasant!"{n}"I was so scared, but{n} {arg} believed you'd{n} surely come to save me!"{n}"That millet dumpling at your waist!{n} Won't you give one to me?{n} I'll join you on your journey!"

strings.en: Momotaro handed a millet dumpling{n}to {arg} the Pheasant!{n}
